entries.mathematical_premise: Over Q, elliptic curves in one isogeny class have the same conductor by isogeny invariance of the l-adic representation.
entries.obstruction: The manuscript's conductor-change examples contradict the Q-isogeny invariant used by Phi.
entries.repair_obligation: Replace variation claim by exact invariance; distinguish model changes and isogeny.
entries.falsifier_or_test: For a specified Q-isogeny, compute conductors with two engines and exhibit equality.

entries.mathematical_premise: Bounding conductor and minimal discriminant separately does not ensure closure under all rational isogenies.
entries.obstruction: A member can have an isogenous partner with different minimal discriminant outside the bound.
entries.repair_obligation: Use explicit isogeny saturation or label the cohort truncated/nonclosed.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Construct exact partner pairs straddling the predeclared discriminant cutoff.

entries.claim: Singleton homology equals cosmic manifold homology
entries.mathematical_premise: A single embedded point has H0=Z and Hk=0 for k>0.
entries.obstruction: An equality H*(Phi(E))=H*(M) cannot hold if M has nonzero H1 or H2.
entries.repair_obligation: Define a finite family, a filtration, and a comparison statistic on clouds, not one point.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Check H1 and H2 of a point explicitly and compare with a circle/sphere target.

entries.claim: Bijection of isogeny classes and cosmic homotopy classes
entries.manuscript_locator: ACSC monograph, prologue and Chapter 2; alternative-mapping criteria, §Bijection
entries.mathematical_premise: The finite-coordinate Phi is not shown injective; the alternative-mapping note calls it many-to-one.
entries.obstruction: The two source statements are in tension without a restricted domain and equivalence relation.
entries.repair_obligation: Specify source/target categories and test injectivity or relax to a many-to-one relation.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Find collisions or indistinguishable image signatures on pinned ecdata; do not interpret class clustering as a bijection.

entries.mathematical_premise: Persistence distances depend on the point-cloud metric, units and filtration normalization.
entries.obstruction: Coordinate rescaling or a changed sample can change Wasserstein distances without changing physical observations.
entries.repair_obligation: Freeze dimensionless metrics, observational masks, sample sizes, nulls and sensitivity controls.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Demonstrate rescaling sensitivity and no advantage against spatial/sampling-matched nulls.

entries.manuscript_locator: ECC manuscript, introduction and entropy-form sections
entries.mathematical_premise: For globally defined C2 real scalar M, d∘d=0.
entries.obstruction: The claimed 2-form omega=d(dM) is identically zero and exact, not a nonzero H2 class.
entries.repair_obligation: Choose a different mathematical model: closed non-exact 1-form, U(1) connection curvature, or exact deformation, clearly separated.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Exact edge coboundary and circle/torus counterexamples; derive the correct cohomology class.

entries.claim: Global potential theta yields nontrivial flux
entries.mathematical_premise: Global theta=dM gives integral over every closed path equal to zero.
entries.obstruction: Nonzero holonomy or flux requires topology, patchwise potentials, connection data or singularities not supplied by theta=dM.
entries.repair_obligation: Specify atlas, bundle, transition laws, gauge invariance and flux normalization.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Integrate dM around a closed loop; independently verify any patchwise transition cocycle.

entries.claim: Hessian trace is Ricci and gradient flow is geodesic
entries.mathematical_premise: Coordinate Hessian trace is not generally an invariant Ricci scalar, and gradient trajectories are not generically geodesics.
entries.obstruction: A nonlinear coordinate change changes an ordinary Hessian; geodesic equation is an additional condition.
entries.repair_obligation: Provide a positive-definite metric, Levi-Civita connection, covariant Hessian, curvature tensor and derived flow law.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Compute a coordinate-change counterexample and residual of geodesic equation for a chosen M.

entries.claim: Entropy probability weights from signed symbolic features
entries.mathematical_premise: Shannon weights require p_i>=0 and sum p_i=1.
entries.obstruction: log(Reg), L_cosmo(1) and rank do not guarantee nonnegative weights or nonzero total.
entries.repair_obligation: Define a strictly positive normalized measure on a declared sample space before entropy is calculated.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Exhibit a negative logarithmic regulator value or zero denominator and require explicit failure.

entries.claim: Unique nonexact class assigned to each curve
entries.mathematical_premise: Uniqueness of a cohomology class does not follow from assigning a point to a manifold.
entries.obstruction: A point alone cannot select a global H2 class without a specified global construction and normalization.
entries.repair_obligation: Construct explicit curve-dependent bundle/connection/functor and prove invariance and uniqueness or withdraw uniqueness.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Use isogenous pairs and distinct curves with same proposed local coordinates.

entries.claim: Conformal mapping preserves exact angle and area
entries.mathematical_premise: A conformal map preserves angles; a nonunit conformal factor scales area by its square in 2D.
entries.obstruction: Simultaneous arbitrary area and angle preservation requires an isometry locally, not merely conformality.
entries.repair_obligation: Define pullback metric and area form; quantify unavoidable distortions.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Check sphere dilation with conformal factor k and area scaling k².

entries.claim: Radius scaling flattens while preserving all original distances
entries.mathematical_premise: R→kR changes induced metric by k², distances by k, sphere area by k² and 3-sphere volume by k³.
entries.obstruction: Restoring original lengths by compensating metric change restores the original intrinsic curvature; cannot claim both for same intrinsic metric.
entries.repair_obligation: Use separate visualization metric and physical metric, and report which is invariant.
entries.falsifier_or_test: For k>1 calculate Gaussian curvature and geodesic distance under both metrics.

entries.mathematical_premise: FLRW permits different curvature signs; positive curvature is a hypothesis requiring observational inference.
entries.obstruction: Choosing k=+1 is not itself an observational validation of global spatial topology.
entries.repair_obligation: Register closed/flat/open rivals, curvature priors and actual likelihood comparisons.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Fit or cite independent curvature constraints; report results without assuming closure.

entries.claim: Comoving volume and light travel distance invariant solely from comoving coordinates
entries.mathematical_premise: Coordinate labels are not physical observables; comoving distance and light travel time have different expansion integrals.
entries.obstruction: A uniform coordinate remapping cannot certify both volumetric and null-geodesic invariance for a changed geometry.
entries.repair_obligation: Derive a(t), metric, null geodesics, Jacobian/volume form, observational redshift relation and transformation laws.
entries.falsifier_or_test: Construct a simple FLRW expansion example and compare light-travel versus comoving distance.
